tagline: Sample chain-scoped assistants for website demos — local ops first, Transition Agents for Europe-wide sustainability.
storyIntro: Restaurant Assist is your on-site co-pilot for a sample wok restaurant: equipment on this venue, local events and catering, and the buildings dashboard pattern. When a question needs Europe-wide grants, finance, or marketplace depth, Assist brings in a Transition Agent, then helps you apply the answer to this chain.
bestFor: Site managers checking tonight’s events or catering demand nearby
Ops leads comparing this venue’s equipment to efficient alternatives
Owners who want NL / EU funding and payback without leaving this restaurant context
